duration.text: The Petroleum Engineering at Southwest Petroleum University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

materials.text: "*" means necessary documents that you must provide in your application.*1. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.*2. requirements.text: Non-Chinese citizens with the age of 18 to 25 who are in good health and willing to abide by Chinese laws and regulations, Southwest Petroleum University rules and regulations, respect Chinese customs, and abide by social ethics.English proficiency certificate(IELTS, TOFEL or certificate of English level of previous degree).
